question: What day of the week was January 1, 2000?
explanation: January 1, 2000 was a Saturday. This is a standard reference date used in calendar problems.

question: How many odd days are there in a leap year?
explanation: A leap year has 366 days. 366 = 52 weeks + 2 days. So there are 2 odd days in a leap year.

question: How many odd days are there in an ordinary year?
explanation: An ordinary year has 365 days. 365 = 52 weeks + 1 day. So there is 1 odd day in an ordinary year.

question: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 100 days?
explanation: 100 days = 14 weeks + 2 days. Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

question: What is the maximum number of Sundays in a year?
explanation: A year has 52 complete weeks plus 1 or 2 extra days. If one of those extra days is Sunday, there can be 53 Sundays.

question: If March 5, 2020 is Thursday, what day is March 5, 2021?
explanation: 2020 is a leap year, so from March 5, 2020 to March 5, 2021 is 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Thursday + 2 = Saturday. Wait — from March 5 to March 5 next year: 2020 is leap but March 5 is after Feb 29, so only 365 days pass. 365 = 52 weeks + 1 day. Thursday + 1 = Friday.

question: How many days are there in 4 years (including one leap year)?
explanation: 3 ordinary years = 3 × 365 = 1095 days. 1 leap year = 366 days. Total = 1095 + 366 = 1461 days.

question: Which year is a leap year among the following?
explanation: A century year is a leap year only if divisible by 400. 2000 ÷ 400 = 5, so 2000 is a leap year. 1900, 1800, 1700 are not.

question: If today is Friday, what day was it 50 days ago?
explanation: 50 = 7 × 7 + 1. So 50 days ago was 1 day before Friday = Thursday. Wait: 50 mod 7 = 1. Friday - 1 = Thursday.

question: The calendar for the year 2003 is the same as which year?
What day of the week is 1st January 1901?
explanation: 1 Jan 1900 was Monday. 1900 is not a leap year, so 1 odd day. Monday + 1 = Tuesday. So 1 Jan 1901 is Tuesday.

question: If 15th August 2023 is Tuesday, what day is 15th August 2024?
explanation: 2024 is a leap year. From Aug 15, 2023 to Aug 15, 2024 = 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Tuesday + 2 = Thursday.

question: How many odd days are there in 100 years?
explanation: 100 years = 76 ordinary years + 24 leap years. Odd days = 76×1 + 24×2 = 76 + 48 = 124 = 17 weeks + 5 days. So 5 odd days.

question: If January 1 of a year is Sunday, what day is February 1 of the same year (non-leap year)?
explanation: January has 31 days. 31 mod 7 = 3. Sunday + 3 = Wednesday.

question: What day of the week does a non-leap year start and end on the same day?
options: Only if it starts on Sunday
Only if it starts on Saturday
explanation: A non-leap year has 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. So it starts and ends on different days. Actually this is false — the question tests the concept. A non-leap year starts and ends on the SAME day of the week is FALSE. The correct answer here is Never true.

question: Today is Wednesday. After 94 days, what day will it be?
explanation: 94 mod 7 = 94 - 91 = 3. Wednesday + 3 = Saturday. Wait: 94/7 = 13 weeks + 3 days. Wednesday + 3 days = Saturday.

question: Which of the following years is NOT a leap year?
explanation: 2100 is a century year not divisible by 400, so it is not a leap year. 2004, 2008 are divisible by 4. 2400 is divisible by 400.

question: If 1st April 2018 is Sunday, what day is 1st April 2019?
explanation: 2018 is not a leap year. From April 1, 2018 to April 1, 2019 = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. Sunday + 1 = Monday.

question: How many Mondays are there in the month of February 2021?
explanation: February 2021 has 28 days (not a leap year). Feb 1, 2021 is Monday. So Mondays fall on 1, 8, 15, 22 — total 4 Mondays.

question: What is the day of the week on 17th June 1998?
explanation: Using Zeller's or odd days method: 17 June 1998. Reference: 1 Jan 1900 = Monday. Calculate total odd days to 17 June 1998. The answer is Wednesday.

question: On what day of the week was 4th February 1999?
explanation: 1 Jan 1900 = Monday. Years 1900-1998: 99 years = 75 ordinary + 24 leap = 75 + 48 = 123 odd days = 17w + 4 days. 1 Jan 1999 = Monday + 4 = Friday. Jan has 31 days, so Feb 1 = Friday + 3 = Monday. Feb 4 = Monday + 3 = Thursday.

question: If 26th January 2020 is Sunday, what day of the week is 26th January 2022?
explanation: 2020 is leap year. From Jan 26, 2020 to Jan 26, 2021: 366 days = 52w + 2 days. Sunday + 2 = Tuesday. From Jan 26, 2021 to Jan 26, 2022: 365 days = 52w + 1 day. Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday.

question: A man was born on 29th February 1988. How many birthdays has he celebrated by 2020 (counting only Feb 29)?
explanation: Leap years from 1988 to 2020: 1992, 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 = 8 leap years. So he celebrated 8 birthdays on Feb 29.

question: What day of the week was 15th August 1947?
explanation: 1 Jan 1900 = Monday. 1900-1946: 47 years = 36 ordinary + 11 leap = 36 + 22 = 58 odd days = 8w + 2 days. 1 Jan 1947 = Monday + 2 = Wednesday. Jan(31=3), Feb(28=0), Mar(31=3), Apr(30=2), May(31=3), Jun(30=2), Jul(31=3), Aug 1-15 = 15 days. Total = 3+0+3+2+3+2+3+15 = 31 days = 4w+3. Wednesday + 3 = Saturday. Hmm, historical record confirms Aug 15, 1947 = Friday.

question: The year 2016 had its calendar same as which previous year?
explanation: For two years to have the same calendar, the total odd days between them must be 0 (mod 7). From 1988 to 2016 = 28 years. In 28 years there are exactly 7 leap years, giving 28 + 7 = 35 odd days = 5 weeks = 0 mod 7. So 1988 and 2016 have the same calendar.

question: If today is Tuesday, what day of the week will it be 999 days from now?
What day of the week is 29th February 2000?
explanation: 1 Jan 2000 was Saturday. Jan has 31 days (31 mod 7 = 3). Feb 1 = Saturday + 3 = Tuesday. Feb 29 = Tuesday + 28 = Tuesday (28 mod 7 = 0). So Feb 29, 2000 = Tuesday.

question: If 1st January 2010 is Friday, what day is 31st December 2010?
explanation: 2010 is not a leap year. 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. Jan 1 = Friday, so Dec 31 = Friday + 1 - 1 = Friday. Actually Dec 31 is the 365th day. Day 1 is Friday, Day 365 = Friday + 364 = Friday + 0 (364 mod 7 = 0) = Friday.

question: How many times does the 29th day of a month occur in 400 years?
explanation: In 400 years: 12 months × 400 = 4800 occurrences of 29th. Subtract months without 29th: Feb in non-leap years (303 times). 4800 - 303 = 4497.

question: Ravi was born on 5th March 1995 (Sunday). On which day will his 25th birthday fall?
explanation: From March 5, 1995 to March 5, 2020 = 25 years. Leap years in this range: 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016, 2020 = 7 leap years. But March 5 is after Feb 29, so 2020 doesn't count as leap for this period. Leap years: 1996, 2000, 2004, 2008, 2012, 2016 = 6. Ordinary years = 19. Odd days = 19×1 + 6×2 = 19 + 12 = 31 = 4w + 3. Sunday + 3 = Wednesday. Hmm, let me recount: 25 years, leap years after March 5: 1996,2000,2004,2008,2012,2016 = 6 leap, 19 ordinary. Odd days = 19+12=31, 31 mod 7=3. Sunday+3=Wednesday.

question: What day of the week was 1st January 1600?
explanation: Using the fact that 1 Jan 1900 = Monday and working backwards: 300 years back. 300 years = 1 odd day (since 200 years = 3 odd days, 100 years = 5 odd days, 300 years = 1 odd day). Monday - 1 = Sunday. Actually 1 Jan 1600 = Saturday by historical calculation.

question: If 25th December 2022 is Sunday, what day is 25th December 2023?
explanation: 2023 is not a leap year. From Dec 25, 2022 to Dec 25, 2023 = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. Sunday + 1 = Monday.

question: In a particular year, the month of January had exactly 5 Saturdays. The first day of January was which day?
explanation: January has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days. For 5 Saturdays, Saturday must fall in the last 3 days (29, 30, 31). If Jan 1 = Thursday, then Jan 29 = Thursday, Jan 30 = Friday, Jan 31 = Saturday — only 4 Saturdays. If Jan 1 = Friday, Saturdays on 2,9,16,23,30 = 5 Saturdays. If Jan 1 = Saturday, Saturdays on 1,8,15,22,29 = 5 Saturdays. If Jan 1 = Thursday, Saturdays on 3,10,17,24,31 = 5 Saturdays. So Thursday, Friday, or Saturday work. The answer is Thursday.

question: The first day of a leap year is Friday. What day is the last day of that year?
explanation: A leap year has 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. If Jan 1 = Friday, then Dec 31 = Friday + 2 - 1 = Saturday. (Day 1 is Friday, Day 366 = Friday + 365 mod 7 = Friday + 1 = Saturday.)

question: If 1st October 2019 is Tuesday, what day is 1st November 2019?
explanation: October has 31 days. 31 mod 7 = 3. Tuesday + 3 = Friday.

question: What will be the day of the week on 1st January 2050?
explanation: 1 Jan 2000 = Saturday. From 2000 to 2050 = 50 years. Leap years: 2000,2004,...,2048 = 13 leap years. Ordinary = 37. Odd days = 37 + 26 = 63 = 9 weeks = 0 mod 7. Saturday + 0 = Saturday.

question: A week starts on Monday. What is the 100th day of the year if January 1 is Wednesday?
explanation: Jan 1 = Wednesday (day 1). Day 100 = Wednesday + 99 days. 99 mod 7 = 1. Wednesday + 1 = Thursday. Wait: 99 = 14×7 + 1. Wednesday + 1 = Thursday.

question: If February 1, 2016 is Monday, what day is March 1, 2016?
explanation: 2016 is a leap year, so February has 29 days. 29 mod 7 = 1. Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

question: How many odd days are there in 200 years?
explanation: 100 years = 5 odd days. 200 years = 10 odd days = 1 week + 3 days = 3 odd days.

question: If 5th January 2014 is Sunday, what day is 5th January 2015?
explanation: 2014 is not a leap year. 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. Sunday + 1 = Monday.

question: What day of the week was 22nd April 2015?
explanation: 1 Jan 2015 = Thursday. Jan(31=3), Feb(28=0), Mar(31=3), Apr 1-22 = 22 days. Total from Jan 1: 31+28+31+22 = 112 days. Day 1 = Thursday, Day 112 = Thursday + 111 mod 7 = Thursday + 6 = Wednesday.

question: In which year will the calendar of 2019 repeat?
If 1st March 2020 is Sunday, what day is 1st March 2021?
explanation: From March 1, 2020 to March 1, 2021 = 365 days (2020 is leap but Feb 29 is before March 1, so this period doesn't include Feb 29 of 2020 or 2021). 365 = 52w + 1. Sunday + 1 = Monday.

question: What day of the week was 26th January 1950?
explanation: 1 Jan 1900 = Monday. 1900-1949: 50 years = 38 ordinary + 12 leap = 38 + 24 = 62 odd days = 8w + 6. 1 Jan 1950 = Monday + 6 = Sunday. Jan 1-26 = 26 days. 26 mod 7 = 5. Sunday + 5 - 1 = Thursday. (Day 1 = Sunday, Day 26 = Sunday + 25 mod 7 = Sunday + 4 = Thursday.)

question: A calendar for 2007 can be used again in which year?
How many Sundays are there from 1st January 2023 to 31st December 2023?
explanation: 2023 is not a leap year. Jan 1, 2023 = Sunday. 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day. Since it starts on Sunday, Sundays fall on Jan 1, 8, 15... The last Sunday is Dec 31 (since Dec 31 = Sunday + 364 mod 7 = Sunday + 0 = Sunday). So there are 53 Sundays.

question: If 1st January 2023 is Sunday, how many Sundays are there in 2023?
explanation: 2023 has 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 extra day. Since Jan 1 = Sunday, the extra day is also Sunday (Dec 31 = Sunday). So there are 53 Sundays.

question: What is the day of the week on 1st September 2015?
explanation: 1 Jan 2015 = Thursday. Days from Jan 1 to Sep 1: Jan(31)+Feb(28)+Mar(31)+Apr(30)+May(31)+Jun(30)+Jul(31)+Aug(31) = 243 days. Day 244 = Sep 1. Thursday + 243 mod 7 = Thursday + 243 - 34×7 = Thursday + 243 - 238 = Thursday + 5 = Tuesday.
